call_points.text: EBITDA margins expected to normalize in Q3 and Q4 with inventory calibrated to market conditions.
No numeric net sales guidance for FY27; management said it will not hover in high single or low double digits.
The 90,000 KL Jodhpur water-based plant is in final commissioning, with trial production expected in June 2026.
Solvent-based and expanded putty plants at Jodhpur have already started production.
No further major capex is envisaged until FY29, with free cash flow expected to step up from FY27.
Key raw material prices rose 50-100% in March 2026; the industry took about 12% price increases, covering water-based costs fully.
Q4 standalone gross margin was 48.6% versus 47.4% a year ago; management expects a return to earlier levels by Q2FY27.
All four product categories grew in Q4; primers and distemper led with 14.9% value and 9.6% volume growth.
Distribution reached over 19,350 active dealers, more than 12,200 tinting machines and 55 depots across 28 states at 31 March 2026.
Management said competitive intensity has normalised and JSW's acquisition of Akzo has not changed behaviour on the ground so far.
April growth was helped by dealers stocking up after price hikes; management flagged some overstocking and said May-June demand is uncertain.

operating_notes.text: FY26 consolidated raw material cost was ₹707.49 Cr, 50.4% of revenue, against ₹689.01 Cr in FY25.
The group operates as a single reportable segment (paints and allied products) under Ind AS 108.
Apple Chemie India Private Limited (51% subsidiary) contributed FY26 revenue of ₹75.06 Cr and net profit after tax of ₹5.17 Cr.
Q4FY26 standalone gross margin was 48.6% versus 47.4% a year ago despite key raw material prices rising 50-100% in March 2026.
Distribution at 31 March 2026: over 19,350 active dealers, more than 12,200 tinting machines and 55 depots across 28 states.
Solvent-based paints (enamels and wood coatings) are 17-18% of the product portfolio and still have an uncovered raw material cost gap.
Apple Chemie India Private Limited recorded a 35.3% growth.
Trial production at the Jodhpur water-based plant (90,000 KLPA capacity) started in September 2026.
